notes.title: Korean Translation Update
notes.notes:
We're so excited to announce the release of the Korean translation of A Summer's End. Please download the latest update on Steam to version 1.3.1 to access the language option in the settings screen. 

To celebrate this update, we’ll be taking part in the upcoming Steam winter sale.

We have plans of adding additional language translations. Please follow our socials and website for future updates. 

We wish everyone happy holidays!

notes.title: Update notes for July 12 1.2.2
notes.notes: We made a minor update in version 1.2.2 to resolve the issue of a few Chinese characters found within the Cantonese translation not displaying properly in the Window versions of the recent Chinese translation update. Thank you so much for your patience and understanding.

notes.title: Chinese Translation Update
notes.notes:
We are happy to announce the Chinese translation of A Summer's End is now available as a free update.

In celebration of this update, we will be hosting a weeklong sale. Thank you very much for your patience. We appreciate everyone's interest and support.

Please update the game to version 1.21 to access new Chinese language options. See the updated game manuals or follow this link​ for installation instructions

Thank you!
